title: 4 Days Yoga, Meditation & Sound Healing Retreat in Ubud, Bali
metaTitle: 4-Day Yoga Retreat in Ubud, Bali | Sound Healing
metaDescription: Join a 4-day yoga retreat in Ubud, Bali with daily asana, meditation and sound healing, accommodation and vegetarian meals. Beginner-friendly.
summary: A four-day immersive retreat combining mindful yoga practice, meditation and restorative sound experiences in the peaceful tropical surroundings of Ubud.
intro: This 4-day yoga retreat in Ubud, Bali is designed as a clear journey—not a crowded wellness package and not an intensive Yoga Teacher Training. Each day connects mindful movement, meditation and conscious sound so you have time to practise, pause and absorb the experience.

Arrive and ground on Day 1, build awareness through movement and breath on Day 2, receive the signature sound experience on Day 3, then integrate your practice before departure on Day 4. Spacious breaks for swimming, journaling and rest keep the rhythm supportive rather than demanding.
Asana creates embodied awareness, meditation develops quiet attention, and sound invites receptive rest. Together, they shape a balanced yoga, meditation and sound healing retreat in Bali.

curriculum.title: Asana
curriculum.summary: Daily guided yoga sessions adapt Hatha and mindful Vinyasa to the group, helping every guest move with more attention and ease.

curriculum.title: Meditation
curriculum.summary: Morning and evening practices give meditation a central place in the retreat, with simple guidance suitable for complete beginners.

curriculum.title: Sound Healing
curriculum.summary: Dedicated sound sessions encourage conscious listening and unhurried rest, followed by quiet time to notice and integrate the experience.
